items.comment: Could you say how DuckDB 1.5.5 was installed (apt/snap/downloaded binary or built from source) and provide crash diagnostics so we can reproduce? Please include either (A) a gdb backtrace from running `gdb --batch -ex "run" -ex "bt" --args duckdb -c "SELECT 1;"` with the same duckdb binary, or (B) the complete stderr output including any core dump instructions and the exact command used. The SQL is minimal so the installation method and crash output are essential to reproduce this segmentation fault.
items.label: needs more info
items.rationale: The report gives the SQL and OS but omits how the DuckDB binary was obtained/built and lacks any crash diagnostics (backtrace or stderr). Without installation/build details and a stack trace or core, the crash cannot be reproduced or diagnosed.
